 Calendar
 October 1, 2026: The 2027 Scholastic Art & Writing Awards open for entries.
 December 1, 2026: The first regional entry deadline. Deadlines vary depending on your region. Some are as late as January 4, 2027. Use our Region Locator to find your deadline. You might have different art and writing deadlines. 
 January 27, 2027: Regional Announcement Day! The Scholastic Awards Entry Portal is updated with results of regional judging!
 While some regions may announce earlier, official results and certificates for all participants will be available after this day. Log in, download your certificates, and celebrate! Be sure to review your region’s information page .
 March 31, 2027: National Announcement Day! Regional Gold Key winners see how their work fared on the national stage. Results from national judging and scholarship committees are announced!. View the results at medals.artandwriting.org or log in at portal.artandwriting.org .
 June 8–June 11, 2027: National Awards Week in New York City. Gold Medalists and select special award-winners are invited to celebrate with us for the National Ceremony at Carnegie Hall, the National Exhibition, and more.
 July 1, 2027: The 2027 Scholastic Art & Writing Awards season ends. Teen and educator Portal access ends for the season as we prepare for next year.
 Make sure to download copies of your work and certificates from the portal before this date. They will not be available in your account when we open again in the fall.
 Upcoming Virtual Events
 Inside the Scholastic Awards Webinar Series
 Join the staff of the Scholastic Art & Writing Awards, plus special guests, to learn more about how teens can enter the Awards, how educators can support their students, and what jurors are looking for.
 Registration is required for each event and is first come, first served.
 Getting Your Students Started
 Monday, October 5, 2026 at 7:00 pm ET
 Join the community of nearly 10,000 educators who supported their students in entering the Scholastic Art & Writing Awards last year!
 In this free webinar, you will learn about how to enter the 2027 Scholastic Awards and how you can best support your students through this process. While primarily for educators who are new to the Scholastic Awards, the webinar is open to anyone interested. 
 Register Now 
 Meet the Writing Jurors
 Thursday, October 15, 2026 at 7:00 pm ET
 Come peek behind the curtain! Past Scholastic Awards writing jurors discuss how they adjudicate according to our three criteria: originality, skill, and the emergence of a personal voice. Out of the hundreds of works they’ve seen, which pieces have stuck most with them, and why? After a panel led by Scholastic Awards’ staff, the jurors will be available for an audience Q&A. 
 Register Now 
 Senior Spotlight! Curating a Scholastic Awards Portfolio
 Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 7:00 pm ET
 Seniors! Now is your time to shine! In this webinar, we will break down how to enter an Art or Writing Portfolio, open to seniors in grade 12 only. 
 Discussion topics will include selecting your works, writing your Artist/Writer Statements and Personal Statements, and other tips and tricks to make your portfolio unforgettable. You’ll get the chance to hear from former Portfolio Award National Medalists, learn how they put their portfolios together, and where they are now. 
 Register Now 
 Meet the Art Jurors
 Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at 7:00 pm ET
 Come peek behind the curtain! Past Scholastic Awards art jurors discuss how they adjudicate according to our three criteria: originality, skill, and the emergence of a personal vision. Out of the hundreds of works they’ve seen, which pieces have stuck most with them, and why? After a panel led by Scholastic Awards’ staff, the jurors will be available for an audience Q&A.
